label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee/community feast in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns. Innkeeper baked and delivered bread; freight coordinated supplies and barter; builder installed lanterns, paid for bread and arranged to escort the mayor under the cover of a lighting/table-layout inspection. Baker knowingly supplied barter bread and promised to keep the surprise private. No evidence secretary or neighbour knowingly helped conceal the feast; secretary scheduled what was presented as an inspection. Mayor was told of the inspection, not the jubilee.
